facts.fact: Tanzania's Ministry of Health told The Citizen that 222 public health facilities, from district to national hospitals, are connected to an integrated electronic medical records system introduced in October 2025 that exchanges patient data between facilities through the Health Data Universal API.
facts.system: Health Data Universal API (HDU API) integrated EMR system

systems.system: Health Data Universal API (HDU API) integrated EMR system
systems.tiers: district, regional referral, zonal, specialised and national hospitals

note: Fact dated to the article's published date, the event date not being given beyond the system's introduction in October 2025.
